rationale: The pip-install job repeatedly downloads pip dependencies on every scheduled run with no dependency cache. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE supports caching dependency downloads to save CI resources. Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable (every run installs pip packages), and cache inputs exist (uv.lock and pyproject.toml for cache-key invalidation). No equivalent pip cache exists (the only existing actions/cache entry is for the Windows ACE installer). Pip cache content is immutable per version and the key invalidates on lockfile/pyproject changes, so cached content is trusted and safe. The change is additive: all existing steps, tests, matrix coverage, and required-check semantics are preserved; no permissions are weakened and no new network access, secrets, or deployment operations are added.
